overview: Before the others came you looked at the roll Garnish had recopied. Nine of the added lines are in a fair hand. Two are struck. The cue is not written yet. Kemp's jokes are not on the page for anyone else to learn.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Checked the fair hand against the two cuts.

parties.name: Abel Garnish
parties.context: Had recopied the roll, and marked it so.

assets.name: Kemp's roll
assets.disposition: Looked at the roll before it was read aloud

summary: Looked at the roll before it was read aloud
